TWENTY-FOUR HOURS IN THE JENSEN HUANG CASE FROM 7PM TO 7PM on 11/22/26

THE MAN BEHIND MEGASPEED

The bears are having their moment.

After predicting a top in the AI trade every month for the last 4 years, the bears finally got their moment last week.

However, in 3 to 6 months, we are going to look back at this correction and realize it was just that: a correction.

There is a widespread narrative right now that Nvidia, $NVDA, is quite literally going to collapse. This is a stock that was trading at a record high on October 6th, worth nearly $6 trillion, and the inventor of the most advanced chips in the world (it's not even close).

That's how deeply pessimistic sentiment has become over the last seven weeks.

Even if Nvidia produced half as much revenue as they are guiding for their next fiscal year, this company would still produce close to $400 billion in annual revenue.

Meanwhile, the S&P 500 has posted three consecutive quarters with earnings growth above 25% and eight straight quarters of double-digit growth.

And, sentiment flipped so quickly that the S&P 500 closed the week 4.1 standard deviations below its 50-day moving average on Friday. Not even 2020 and 2008 saw such an occurrence.

The reality is that AI truly is the "next big thing" and the AI buildout is only accelerating.

Bears will sound smart, bulls will make money.
